question: In view of the recent fires that have devastated areas in Galicia forming part of the Natura 2000 network, including the Macizo Central SAC, the Pena Trevinca SAC, exacerbating the consequences of poor management by the Xunta de Galicia of the areas protected by the Natura 2000 network, as demonstrated both by the fact that there is an ongoing infringement procedure and by the Commission’s replies1, the following questions are put to the Commission: 1.

Can the Commission confirm whether the Natura 2000 areas of the Macizo Central SAC (affected by the major fire in Chandrexa de Queixa this summer) and the Pena Trevinca SAC (affected by another major fire this summer) are the subject of an appropriate and current management plan, in accordance with EU legislation, and whether or not they are concerned by an ongoing infringement procedure for failure to comply with obligations under the Habitats Directive and the Birds Directive?

Can the Commission set out the situation regarding the existence of management plans and the possible inclusion in infringement proceedings of all other Natura 2000 areas in Galicia, in particular those recently affected by forest fires?
